implemented: Created the model_maven_worker Python package and moved the shared protocol constants and UserError type into protocol.py.

Moved environment lock validation, interpreter selection, dependency resolution, environment snapshots/checks, path handling and subprocess helpers into environment.py. The worker package imports this module as its environment domain.
Kept python/worker.py as a small compatibility launcher.
PythonBackend stages the worker entrypoint and package modules into a fresh temporary directory, independent of repository cwd or installed Model-Maven Python packages.
Training export now includes the same package initializer, protocol module and environment module alongside its compatibility launcher.

Moved static component discovery, entry-point validation, distribution source mapping, manifest lookup and project extension path discovery into extensions/catalog.py. The module only imports protocol errors and environment name normalization; it does not import or execute component code.
Added one Rust worker asset manifest and shared staging function used by both the runtime adapter and training export, so each package module is embedded and exported from the same inventory.

Moved batch factory construction and args/kwargs/envelope binding into data/batch.py. The operation receives the Torch module and entrypoint resolver explicitly; model probe, backward verification and component forward smoke share it.

Moved bounded nested Python/Tensor-to-JSON normalization into model/tensor_tree.py. The Torch module is an explicit argument, including during recursive traversal, so this model helper has no mutable worker-global dependency.

Moved stable module instance enumeration, persistent Layer path normalization and submodule resolution into model/structure.py. These helpers do not import Torch or worker-global state and are shared by inspect, edit and provider flows.

Moved editable-parameter descriptions, safe source-constructor fields, state migration boundaries and model inspection reports into model/inspection.py. The module receives Torch, source-site evidence and container capability through explicit arguments; compatibility routing in the package initializer assembles them.

Moved model injection schema validation, project construction-site discovery and native nn.Module construction capture into model/construction.py. Torch, entrypoint resolution and module identity enumeration are explicit; source locations/counts return to the compatibility layer as data.

Moved real-batch forward call tracing and loss/backward gradient verification into model/probe.py. Torch, entrypoint and batch resolvers, model-path helpers, tensor-tree encoding and invocation cap are explicit dependencies; package-level wrappers preserve existing dispatch callers.

Moved managed AdamW step execution into train/managed.py. Added TrainingRuntime as an explicit dependency bundle for Torch, entrypoint resolution, Tensor summaries, StepContext and metric validation; the worker initializer retains a compatibility router.

Moved manual-step optimizer registration, gradient/parameter finite checks and named optimizer state persistence into train/manual.py. It shares TrainingRuntime with managed training. A first regression run exposed and fixed a stale StepContext reference and missing re import.
Moved external-loop progress context, budget and parameter checks, stop-file polling and checkpoint-boundary handoff into train/external.py, reusing TrainingRuntime with managed/manual engines.
Added a repeatable external-loop CLI integration case that exercises step budget reporting, user optimizer updates, finite checks and latest checkpoint persistence.

Moved checkpoint payload validation, source-bound run signatures, model state fingerprints, atomic checkpoint writes and compatibility-checked checkpoint loading into train/checkpoint.py. The worker initializer passes Torch explicitly through compatibility wrappers.

Moved training operation preflight, environment/source drift checks, bounded-run routing and provenance attachment into train/probe.py. TrainingProbeRuntime supplies environment, entrypoint, source manifest, execution callbacks and Python/PyTorch runtime identity explicitly; the package initializer remains a compatibility router.

Moved formal managed/manual/external training-run orchestration, checkpoint cadence, state-hook capture/restore, recovery status and progress-event production into train/runner.py. TrainingRunRuntime explicitly supplies checkpoint, engine, runtime identity and progress callbacks; the initializer retains the worker protocol adapter.

Moved native Layer construction and Sequential/ModuleList/ModuleDict add, set, replace, remove, bypass, shared-alias replacement and transaction replay into edit/layers.py. LayerEditRuntime explicitly supplies Torch, entrypoint loading, module path/alias services and editable-field discovery; compatibility wrappers preserve worker callers.

Moved persisted edit-operation and variant-history integrity validation into edit/variants.py. EditValidationRuntime explicitly provides allowed actions, canonical digest calculation and model-injection schema validation; compatibility wrappers preserve existing dispatch and edit-plan callers.

Moved variant edit planning into edit/plan.py, including undo/redo cursor handling, transaction checks, base reconstruction and history replay, optional forward validation, and source/component fingerprint publication. EditPlanRuntime supplies model loading, validation, component verification, source edits, probe and inspection services explicitly.

Moved AST source offsets, collision-free generated aliases, built-in/custom factory expressions and readable Sequential/ModuleList/ModuleDict source rebuilding into edit/source_ast.py. The worker initializer retains compatibility names for source candidate handlers.

Moved direct-assignment source CRUD candidate generation for native Sequential/ModuleList/ModuleDict containers into edit/source_candidates.py. SourceCandidateRuntime supplies model/path operations, AST generators, Layer construction, probe/inspection, and dynamic source-location evidence providers; dynamic providers observe the dictionaries rebound during model construction.

Moved source structural transaction-state discovery into edit/source_candidates.py. It validates container identity, unique construction sites, project-local non-symlink source paths, UTF-8/AST assignments and derives the initial editable source/runtime container state through dynamic construction-site evidence providers.

Moved multi-container source structural transaction planning into edit/source_candidates.py. The executor replays add/replace/remove/bypass operations across native containers, checks overlapping targets and runtime/source state, constructs deterministic initializers, builds per-file patches/diffs, validates complete candidate syntax and optional forward behavior, and preserves the existing recoverable commit contract.

Moved source-set constructor candidate application into edit/source_candidates.py. The helper reconstructs uniquely mapped parameterless custom nn.Module constructors, preserves untouched call arguments, refuses unsupported variadic forms and stateful migration guesses, and reports affected aliases through explicit model/edit runtime services.

Moved multi-target source-set candidate planning into edit/source_candidates.py. The planner rejects duplicate Layer targets, validates project-local and unique construction sites, builds coordinated parameter replacements across source files, detects overlapping patches, enforces snapshot/preview limits, compiles candidate files, applies changes to the disposable model, and runs optional forward validation.

Single-Layer source set candidate planning now lives in edit/source_set.py with an explicit SourceCandidateRuntime; the package initializer retains only source operation dispatch for this path. The new module is included by the shared embedded/export asset manifest.

Layer Edit Provider conformance execution now lives in extensions/conformance.py with an explicit ProviderConformanceRuntime. The worker initializer assembles the runtime dependencies, and Rust embedded/export assets include the conformance module.

Registered Layer component smoke/conformance behavior now lives in extensions/layer_conformance.py with an explicit LayerConformanceRuntime for component resolution, construction, batch creation and tensor summaries. The package initializer keeps component-test routing and runtime assembly.

Extension JSON store scanning, recursive component reference discovery, and project Python import/source inspection now live in extensions/source_inspection.py. Environment path behavior is injected as callbacks, and uninstall/bundle code keeps using the established helper contract.

Project component uninstall planning/application now lives in extensions/lifecycle.py with explicit inspection dependencies. Added an end-to-end apply test. Corrected five malformed shutil.rmtree calls in installer failure cleanup and uninstall rollback/cleanup paths so cleanup failures no longer trigger argument errors.

Project extension wheel build/preflight/install/content-addressed staging/static discovery now lives in extensions/lifecycle.py. ComponentInstallRuntime injects the selected interpreter, project root, environment process runner, dependency validation, wheel hashing and static discovery. Added end-to-end scaffold → wheel build → isolated install → registered component coverage.

Project extension wheel build, build-dependency preflight, content-addressed isolated installation and static component discovery now live in extensions/lifecycle.py. ComponentInstallRuntime injects project root, selected interpreter, process runner, dependency/wheel inspection and discovery. Added scaffold-to-wheel-to-install-to-registration integration coverage.

Extension distribution/dependency closure planning now lives in extensions/bundle.py with an explicit ExtensionBundleRuntime. The scaffold install integration now injects the installed component into a model, trains, exports, and checks the non-empty extension package manifest/vendor archive, exercising the bundle planner through the public product flow.

Moved locked component-manifest loading, dependency-reference checks, distribution verification calls and Provider activation evidence into extensions/references.py. The initializer now supplies runtime fingerprints/digest functions and retains compatibility adapters for existing dispatch and conformance call sites.

Moved environment distribution inventory, package source classification, requirements snapshot generation and environment fingerprint construction into environment.snapshot_environment(). The worker initializer now only injects the currently loaded Torch module and capture timing.

Moved variant/model reconstruction into model/loading.py. The service validates variant origin/seed/runtime/source, verifies component locks, constructs the user model, replays validated edit history and returns origin/effect evidence through explicit runtime dependencies; the initializer now assembles those dependencies.

Created the run worker domain and moved source-manifest capture and drift verification to run/provenance.py. Loaded Python modules are passed explicitly from the composition root; the service owns project path filtering, package-tree capture, hashing and structured drift errors. Updated worker domain checks and embedded assets.

Moved StepContext, scalar/metric validation, finite accumulation, user-callable checkpoint state hooks and Python/Torch RNG checkpoint handling into train/state.py. TrainingStateRuntime receives Torch and Python RNG explicitly; the initializer keeps compatibility wrappers and composes TrainingRuntime.

Moved extension wheel archive safety, metadata parsing, PEP 508 requirement checks and selected-environment lock compatibility into extensions/wheels.py. Environment lock/ABI operations are explicit ComponentWheelRuntime dependencies.

Moved module:callable validation/import into runtime/entrypoints.py and the static doctor capability catalog into runtime/capabilities.py. The composition root only probes current interpreter facts and delegates report construction; stale imports from previous migrations were removed.
